description: The projection from the power set onto its quotient modulo an ideal is a bounded lattice homomorphism, preserving both bounds, intersections, and unions.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.projection.{u} {α : Type u} (I : Order.Ideal (Set α)) :
  BoundedLatticeHom (Set α) (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.SmallQuotient I)
